2607.17733.title: MXSens: Sensitivity-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Inference
2607.17733.paper_summary: 4-bit quantization enables efficient LLM inference, but suffers from significant accuracy degradation due to outliers. Prior work addresses this problem via data rotation or mixed-precision integer quantization, but often relies on software-managed scaling and frequent dequantization, incurring substantial overhead. Microscaling formats, such as MXINT, eliminate these inefficiencies by encoding scales in hardware, yet remain incompatible with rotation-based methods. Our analysis reveals that outliers vary in severity, from rare extremes to frequent mild deviations, and that quantization sensitivity is unevenly distributed across layers and columns. These insights motivate a fine-grained, sensitivity-guided approach. We introduce MXSens, a training-free method that assigns mixed mantissa bitwidths (4/6/8) based on column- and layer-wise sensitivity, naturally leveraging the block-wise structure of MXINT. MXSens outperforms state-of-the-art quantization methods across a range of models and tasks. Under the W4A4KV4 setting, MXSens achieves perplexities of 3.77 and 7.63 on LLaMA-2-70B and LLaMA-3-8B, respectively, substantially improving over existing baselines on WikiText-2. Our work establishes a new balance between accuracy and resource efficiency for LLM quantization.
2607.17733.paper_summary_zh: 4位元量化使得高效的LLM推理成為可能，但由於異常值的存在，準確性顯著下降。先前的研究通過數據旋轉或混合精度整數量化來解決這個問題，但往往依賴於軟體管理的縮放和頻繁的去量化，導致了可觀的開銷。微縮格式，如MXINT，通過在硬體中編碼縮放來消除這些低效率，但仍然與基於旋轉的方法不兼容。我們的分析顯示，異常值的嚴重程度各不相同，從罕見的極端到頻繁的輕微偏差，且量化敏感性在層和列之間分佈不均。這些洞察促使我們採取一種細粒度的、敏感性引導的方法。我們介紹了MXSens，一種無需訓練的方法，根據列和層的敏感性分配混合尾數位寬（4/6/8），自然利用了MXINT的區塊結構。MXSens在多個模型和任務上超越了最先進的量化方法。在W4A4KV4設置下，MXSens在LLaMA-2-70B和LLaMA-3-8B上分別達到了3.77和7.63的困惑度，顯著改善了WikiText-2上的現有基準。我們的工作在LLM量化中建立了準確性和資源效率之間的新平衡。
